name: Charlotte Eckerhardin
original_name: シャルロッテ＝エッケハルディン
source:
Star Sign: Libra
Elemental Attribute: Earth
Special Attribute: None
Starting Spells: Fire 3/Lighting 3/Ice 3/Holy 5/Healing 4/Aging 2
Symbol: A wand with the Eckerhardin coat of arms on it(Level 4)

A great beauty with dynamite proportions.
She's Yuri's fiancee, but it seems the relationship doesn't have mutual feelings.
The one she's really fixated on is Akito who got the highest score on the admissions test. She is determined to make him her "Partner" any way necessary.
